title: ASP.NET Web API Quick Reference
description: Look up a lesson idea, see its small example, and check a common mistake. Open the linked lesson for setup and practice steps.

entries.name: Make a controller action
entries.summary: A controller action handles a route. HttpGet maps GET /hello to the method.
notes: AddControllers and MapControllers are both needed.

entries.name: Return a JSON object
entries.summary: Ok creates a successful response with data. Open GET /book.
notes: Return data objects so the framework serialises them.

entries.name: Bind a route number
entries.summary: FromRoute reads a path value. Open GET /double/4.
notes: A route constraint controls matching; it is not a full data validation policy.

entries.name: Read a query input
entries.summary: FromQuery makes the source of an input clear. GET /page with no n uses 1.
notes: Inputs from clients still need suitable limits.

entries.name: Read a typed body
entries.summary: FromBody reads a JSON request body. Send POST /books with application/json and {"title":"Moon Trip"}.
notes: Send the correct Content-Type so JSON can be parsed.

entries.name: Use a required field rule
entries.summary: ApiController checks validation attributes. A valid POST /books with {"title":"Moon Trip"} reaches this action.
notes: Required checks presence; add more rules for your actual needs.

entries.name: Return a new item location
entries.summary: CreatedAtAction sends status 201 and a link to the new item. Send POST /books with {"title":"Moon Trip"}.
notes: The named action and route values must identify a real route.

entries.name: Report a missing book
entries.summary: NotFound creates a 404 result. Open GET /missing.
notes: A missing item should not look like a successful response.

entries.name: Return a typed collection
entries.summary: A collection becomes a JSON array. Open GET /books.
notes: Use a clear item shape for larger collections.

entries.name: Set a controller response header
entries.summary: A controller can set response metadata before returning a result. Open GET /note.
notes: Headers must be set before the response starts.

entries.name: Reply without a body
entries.summary: NoContent returns status 204. Send DELETE /books/1 for this practice response.
notes: This sample only shows the response; it has no stored book to delete.

entries.name: Choose between result kinds
entries.summary: IActionResult allows different outcomes. GET /score/8 returns a success; a negative score returns 400.
notes: Check invalid input before returning a success result.
